title: The slowest request per service
prompt: For each service, the performance team wants its slowest request. Write `solve(api_requests)` with pair RDD functions so it returns `service`, `request_id` and `latency_ms` of the request with the highest latency.
rules: One row per service that has at least one request with a latency. Requests with a missing `latency_ms` are ignored.
If two requests of a service tie for the highest latency, pick the one with the smaller `request_id`.
hints: Make pairs of `(service, (latency_ms, request_id))`, skipping requests with no latency.
Write a function `slower(a, b)` that returns whichever of two `(latency, id)` tuples should win, ties included.
A tie means equal latency: then the smaller id wins. Plain `max` on the tuples picks the larger id.
